lore_summary.en: Queen, lover, builder. Shirin's courage outlasts the empires around her.
lore_summary.fa: شیرین ملکه ارمنی خسرو پرویز بود که نه تنها قلب خسرو بلکه قلب فرهاد تراشکار را هم تسخیر کرد — فرهادی که خسرو با دروغ به مرگش محکوم کرد. پس از کشته شدن خسرو توسط پسرش شیرویه، شیرین از پذیرفتن شیرویه سر باز زد و خود را بر سر مزار خسرو کشت — نه از شکست بلکه از انتخاب.

scenes.body_en: Shirin does not belong to the Shahnameh the way Khosrow does — the Shahnameh is not a romance and does not want to be one. But she appears in it anyway, because she cannot be left out. She was Khosrow Parviz's great queen and his great love, an Armenian Christian woman who outlived his glory, witnessed his fall, and chose how she died. That last choice made her immortal.

The story of Farhad belongs to Shirin's chapter even though it is not about her directly. Farhad was a sculptor and engineer who fell in love with her, and Khosrow — unwilling to share what he considered his — gave him an impossible condition: cut a channel through Mount Bisotun, and you may have her. Farhad went to the mountain and began cutting. He worked so long and so precisely that the task began to look possible. Khosrow sent a messenger to tell him Shirin had died. Farhad threw himself from the cliff. The mountain still bears his carvings. The lie that killed him is in every one of them.

Shirin outlived Farhad, then outlived Khosrow himself. When Shiruyeh killed his father and seized the throne, he sent for Shirin — she was a queen, wealthy, known, and he wanted the legitimacy her presence would provide. She refused. A king who murders his own father to take his crown is not a king she would ornament. She went instead to Khosrow's tomb, and there she died — by her own hand, some versions say; by grief, others say. Both are probably true.

Persian literature after Ferdowsi would build an entire tradition on Shirin's story — Nizami's masterpiece above all. But she is already complete in the Shahnameh: a woman who made two men immortal through loving one and refusing the other, and who chose her ending rather than accept one she had not written.

battle.intro_en: Shirin outlasted Khosrow Parviz, outlasted the wars, outlasted the dynasty. Her courage was quieter than the battles around her and more durable. To face this gate you must understand what the Shahnameh means when it follows a queen instead of a king.
battle.intro_fa: شیرین از خسرو پرویز بلندتر ایستاد، از جنگ‌ها بلندتر، از دودمان بلندتر. شجاعتش آرام‌تر از نبردهایِ پیرامونش بود و ماندنی‌تر. برای مواجهه با این دروازه باید بفهمی شاهنامه هنگامی که به جایِ شاه ملکه را دنبال می‌کند چه مرادی دارد.
